info.title: samwise - bootstrap a repository's AI-assistant setup (Claude Code / Codex / Copilot).
info.description: Samwise is the loyal tool that helps a developer carry their work: it bootstraps a repository's AI-assistant setup (skills, hooks, MCP servers, settings) for Claude Code, and (via renderers) for OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot. Vendor- and org-neutral core; org-specific values are supplied at init time via flags/prompts or an optional --overlay file. Idempotent and re-runnable.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Install skills/playbooks, MCP servers & settings into a repo.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show the neutral core and per-platform outputs.

options.name: --ado-org
options.description:
Azure DevOps organization for the azure-devops MCP server.
If omitted, init prompts for it (Enter to skip).

options.name: --sql-mcp-url
options.description: HTTP endpoint of a SQL/database MCP server (optional).

options.name: --overlay
options.description:
JSON overlay merged on top of the neutral core. May contain
"mcpServers", "skillsDir", and (Claude only) "settings".

options.name: --no-input
options.description: Never prompt; skip optional servers and hook replacement prompts.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files / incompatible config keys.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Show planned changes without writing.
The core is organization-neutral. Org-specific values come only from flags, prompts, or an
--overlay file - nothing org-specific is baked into the package.
Idempotent: re-running is safe. Existing files and config keys are kept unless --force.
Auth is interactive at runtime (GitHub OAuth, Azure DevOps az login) - no tokens are stored.
Hooks/permission profiles are full-fidelity on Claude; on Codex/Copilot they become written guidance.
